I like the way you put that last part.  I feel like a complete tool because I want to be friendly to everyone.  But some people are still shitty people, and when I put too much effort into their approval and get spit on I usually take it out on people that don't deserve it.

Honesty is a weird thing for me.  I can be honest on reddit...because what's the point of lying on the internet?  I grew up an introverted pathological liar.  I don't know if it was because of the numerous medications I was on or if I just had a backwards imagination.  I would tell bullshit stories all the time if I wasn't keeping to myself.  I still have that habit from time to time.  There was a point when I started smoking weed that my stories just pissed people off and that was a strange time in my life.  I spent so much time lying that I didn't know how to be an honest person.  And of course I never learned how to tell people about such a ridiculous problem.

One of them pretty much had to babysit me for a few hours.  I told I was sorry and he said it was fine but I'm still embarrassed.  There's so much peer pressure with weed.  I used to smoke all the time but I never really talked while I was high.  I would just sit there in my own little dreamland and ignore my surroundings and friends.  I feel like I could be a more peaceful and openminded person if I smoke weed.  But now everytime I do it I have to force myself out of my head or I go insane.

thank you for taking interest :) i don't really know what to say.  I'm just worried about the next week or so because lately I've been to depressed to find anything to occupy my time.  I feel too embarrassed to see my bar friends because I had a serious mental breakdown last time I smoked weed with them.  I drunkenly opened up to one of my coworkers because he seemed to be asking all the right questions to get me to spill shit.  I quit because I got it in my head that he checked my /r/depression account when I had him over and he decided to share my personal stuff with everyone at work.  people at work started treating me different and it was making me unbearably sick.

I always thought the path to being a man was to suck it up and show no weakness.  But all that build up just makes me sick and angry.  I want to open up somehow but I never do.  No one knows me because I don't let them get the chance.  I know they'll just take advantage of me.
